Celery & Ginger Juice
By: Cilantro
Published: Monday, February 8, 2010 - 3:16pm

Ingredients




1 bunch celery
2 cups water
3 smalls piece ginger (½ inch piece )
2 tablespoons key limes or approximately 2  lime juice
6 tablespoons honey or 4 teaspoon sugar

Preparation

1 Combine celery and ginger with water in a blender or juicer.  Strain the juice. 2 Add juice of lime ( I used two key limes) 3 Mix in honey or sugar. Combine well.

About


Is celery a boring vegetable to you? Well, it might be until you have tried this juice. I have for many years enjoyed sugarcane juice during the hot summer days while growing up in Hyderabad. Sugarcane, ginger and lime makes it my all time favorite. I recreated the same recipe with celery. The classic old fashioned sugarcane juice takes a modern turn with a twist of celery and a dash of ginger.
Celery, like most vegetables is high in fiber, which is important for helping our digestive system to work the way it is supposed to. Celery also contains high amounts of vitamin C and vitamin K. One stalk of celery contains about 10 calories. Some contend that it contains "negative calories," meaning that one spends more calories digesting it than are consumed, which supposedly helps with weight loss.
